commits.original_subject: chore: Updated Go version to '1.27.3'. BED-10193 (#160)
commits.message:
chore(deps): update Go to 1.27.3

Update the module's Go directive from 1.27.2 to 1.27.3.

Refs: BED-10193 (#160)

feat(testing): require disposable database targets

Add explicit destructive-test opt-in and a credential-free target
allowlist. Wire the guard into integration commands and CI, and document
the required environment variables.

test(regression): establish a cross-backend query corpus

Add shared fixtures, typed parameters, mutation post-state templates and
legacy-builder regressions. Track query-form coverage and validate the
regression manifest.

commits.original_subject: feat(cypher): stage regression forms and PostgreSQL lowering
commits.message:
feat(cypher): add traversal lowering and regression forms

Add traversal admission plans, endpoint and suffix strategies,
shortest-path lowering, path functions and graph-scoped SQL rendering.
Extend parser, builder and SQL regression fixtures.

commits.original_subject: feat(pg): add graph-scoped execution and policy foundations
commits.message:
feat(pg): add graph-scoped execution and traversal policies

Add bounded parse/translation caches, graph-scoped execution, traversal
workspaces and manifest-backed routing policies. Add topology metadata,
schema upgrades and driver regression coverage.

feat(pg-v2): add a connection-local cached driver

Introduce the v2 pool/runtime hooks, per-connection translation
retention, shared shortest-path templates and cache diagnostics. Cover
lifecycle, configuration and live execution.

commits.original_subject: test(pg): cover traversal and mutation integration semantics
commits.message:
test(pg): cover traversal and mutation integration semantics

Add PostgreSQL traversal-plan, inline all-shortest, deletion and
graph-wipe controls. Extend the PostgreSQL walker for the emitted query
forms.

feat(benchmark): add a traversal qualification corpus

Add reproducible traversal scenarios, plan capture and reporting for
both PostgreSQL runtimes. Include scale fixtures and shortest-path
policy selection.

feat(graphbench): add reproducible qualification gates

Add capture bundles, A/A resolution, paired confirmation, resource and
operational gates, and manifest-backed promotion evidence. Include
traversal telemetry, selector studies and reference tournaments.

commits.original_subject: feat(plancorpus): add normalized backend plan deltas
commits.message:
feat(plancorpus): report normalized backend plan deltas

Capture backend-specific plan diagnostics from the shared corpus,
normalize plan structure and report comparable deltas. Extend command
options, output provenance and regression coverage.

commits.original_subject: docs: add durable traversal protocols and operations guidance
commits.message:
docs(traversal): document qualification and routing protocols

Record traversal experiments, routing and promotion contracts,
source-parity procedures and operational limits. Update translation,
development and repository guidance.

commits.original_subject: fix(pg-v2): lower first-use topology retry candidates
commits.message:
fix(pg): lower first-use topology retry candidates

Admit the first-use fixed-suffix policy to guarded suffix lowering and
emit the transaction-retry form. Add a regression for the versioned
selector.

commits.original_subject: fix(pg): preserve expansion path identity and order
commits.message:
fix(pg): preserve expansion identity and path order

Hydrate repeated expansion endpoints once and reverse raw path-ID
segments with the other path components. Cover self-loop aliases and
reversed suffix paths.

commits.original_subject: test(graphbench): skip PostgreSQL WAL probe on Neo4j
commits.message:
test(graphbench): skip the PostgreSQL WAL probe on Neo4j

Select the PostgreSQL-only adjacency feasibility probe by
CONNECTION_STRING so Neo4j integration runs skip it.

feat(pg)!: consolidate the connection-local driver runtime

Move the v2 runtime, pool hooks, translation cache and diagnostics into
drivers/pg. Remove the separate v2 driver and obsolete shared SQL
translation implementation.

BREAKING CHANGE: callers of drivers/pg/v2 must migrate to drivers/pg and
construct pools with pg.NewPool or pg.NewPoolWithRuntimeConfig.

fix(pg): preserve all-shortest harness argument positions

Distinguish SP and ASP endpoint-array offsets so singleton all-shortest
calls retain their maximum-depth argument. Add a compiler regression and
the crypto module requirement.

chore(deps): update Go dependencies and checksums

Upgrade CUE, RoaringBitmap, bitset, go-pretty, compress and indirect
dependencies, and refresh go.sum.

commits.original_subject: chore: remove live dataset guards and broken tests
commits.message:
fix(pg): rebind cached literals and remove database guards

Retain formatter-extracted string literals separately from request
parameters and rebind both on cache hits. Remove disposable-target
guards, align callers and SQL fixtures with formatted statements, and
update test setup.

fix(pg): retain constrained aggregate traversal semantics

Decline aggregate-count lowering when the second MATCH labels the source
or reuses it as the terminal. Add shared read/mutation controls,
PostgreSQL plan checks and review findings.

fix(pg): preserve bound traversal and multipart inputs

Keep bound endpoint identity, carried node representations and
inline-map dependencies. Repair leading UNWIND/CREATE frames, hoist
write CTEs, and decline unsafe correlated suffix reversal.

fix(pg): stage multipart writes for read-after-write visibility

Execute later multipart stages as separate statements in the same
transaction, retaining carried rows and updated aliases. Fix empty-list
aliases and bound suffix admission, and make pool/runtime references
weak.

docs(variance): record backend semantic findings

Add the detailed variance investigation covering query semantics,
drivers, values, analysis utilities and transfer tooling.

fix(bdd): enforce supported scenarios and Go test failures

Remove the TestMain exit override, enforce untagged scenarios and
explicitly tag unsupported compatibility cases as report-only. Validate
runner/report consistency and record the prioritized variance findings.

Refs: DAWGS-084
commits.review_note: The original DAWGS-041 subject is incorrect: this changes the DAWGS-084 BDD gate, not SET translation.

commits.message:
fix(graph): preserve update rows and batch mutation intent

Preserve SET input rows, duplicates and null targets while binding
assignments to each target's input frame. Frame typed batch identities,
propagate Neo4j property deletions and apply PostgreSQL upsert kind
removals transactionally.

Refs: DAWGS-041, DAWGS-064, DAWGS-070, DAWGS-087
commits.review_note: This combined changeset implements the SET row-stream repair and three batch repairs.

commits.message:
fix(cypher): preserve SET and REMOVE clause order

Apply property and kind mutation intent in clause order while retaining
one write per target and the complete input row stream. Dependent
assignment-expression sequencing remains separate work.

Refs: DAWGS-045

fix(pg): distinguish builder ASTs in translation cache keys

Add a bounded typed AST fingerprint in a separate builder identity
domain. Preserve same-shape parameter rebinding and bypass reuse for
unsupported fingerprint shapes.

Refs: DAWGS-058

fix(algo): cache complete requested reachability sets

Retain only complete requested-component reach sets across diamonds,
SCCs, directions and eviction. Add concurrent-read regressions and
record the bulk-query performance follow-up.

Refs: DAWGS-073

fix(retriever): classify nested scrub keys recursively

Apply key-specific policy within nested maps and arrays, retaining
explicit preserve overrides and parent redaction. Advance scrub policy
identity and cover checkpoint/output accounting.

Refs: DAWGS-080

fix(import): preserve exact numbers and contain fragment reads

Normalize JSON integer tokens without float64 rounding and reject
overflow before writes. Use a root-aware opener for checksum, preflight
and load reads to reject parent-relative and symlink escapes.

Refs: DAWGS-101, DAWGS-102

fix(cypher): keep Boolean operands inside value expressions

Extract predicates at WHERE boundaries instead of turning AND operands
in projections or assignments into row filters. Add shared read and
complete mutation-state regressions.

Refs: DAWGS-006

fix(pg): retain expansion endpoint predicates in continuations

Render pending cross-endpoint predicates over materialized
variable-length endpoints before fixed continuation steps. Cover exact
paths, duplicate rows and mutation selection.

Refs: DAWGS-028

fix(pg): preserve duplicate OPTIONAL MATCH input identity

Number input rows and correlate derived optional matches by row identity
rather than equal exported values. Remove internal identities from
visible projections and cover mutation cardinality.

Refs: DAWGS-024

fix(pg): correlate reused relationship variables by identity

Allocate a fresh edge alias for each fixed relationship occurrence and
constrain it to the previously bound relationship ID. Add shared path,
row-count and mutation regressions.

Refs: DAWGS-026
commits.review_note: The original DAWGS-027 subject is incorrect; this is the DAWGS-026 reused-relationship repair.

commits.message:
fix(pg): pair undirected continuation endpoints correctly

Bind near and far orientations together so a later undirected hop
reaches the opposite endpoint. Preserve self-loop handling and cover
exact paths and complete mutation state.

Refs: DAWGS-027

fix(pg): enforce relationship uniqueness across MATCH parts

Track relationship history across comma-separated pattern parts and
consecutive expansions. Preserve duplicate inputs, optional null rows
and mixed fixed/variable path semantics.

Refs: DAWGS-031

fix(pg): constrain repeated undirected endpoints to self-loops

Require both endpoints to equal the repeated local node for patterns
such as (x)-[r]-(x). Preserve unrelated input rows and cover exact
relationship/path identities.

Refs: DAWGS-033

fix(cypher): normalize exact-length relationship ranges

Parse *k as *k..k and accept whitespace and comments within ranges.
Cover zero, short and above-15-hop paths plus complete mutation
post-state.

Refs: DAWGS-020

fix(ops): cancel parallel fetch submission on worker failure

Deliver the originating worker error, cancel the operation context to
unblock submission, and join all workers. Cover both parallel fetch
helpers, caller cancellation and successful ranges.

Refs: DAWGS-072

test(pg): reproduce kind-registration pool wedges

Add bounded single-connection, saturated-pool and read-side miss probes
plus a cached-kind control. Pin the existing nested-acquisition behavior
without claiming a runtime repair.

Refs: DAWGS-065
commits.review_note: This commit adds reproductions only; the repair arrives in cdfadee7.

commits.message:
fix(cardinality): avoid nested wrapper locks in binary operations

Snapshot thread-safe operands before locking the receiver, preventing
cross-wrapper and self-operation deadlocks. Preserve wrapped HyperLogLog
merges and cover both bitmap widths.

Refs: DAWGS-099

fix(cardinality): avoid mutation during bitmap fallback iteration

Copy non-native Duplex operands into a native bitmap before And or
AndNot on both widths. Cover native, wrapped, custom and
container-boundary cases.

Refs: DAWGS-076
commits.review_note: The original DAWGS-077 subject is incorrect; this is the DAWGS-076 bitmap fallback repair.

commits.message:
fix(container): preserve merged values and terminate EFSet search

Store PackedMap's merged values alongside merged keys. Return no match
for empty EFSet inputs and targets below the stored minimum.

Refs: DAWGS-077

fix(traversal): preserve step direction and optional cardinality

Fetch each following expansion with its own direction and let preserved
optional segments expand once. Add exact callback-cardinality controls
and supplementary EFSet regressions.

Refs: DAWGS-074, DAWGS-095, DAWGS-077
commits.review_note: Runtime changes repair DAWGS-074 and DAWGS-095; DAWGS-077 receives additional tests only.

commits.message:
fix(pg): contain quantifier projections and propagate fetch errors

Avoid nil-pattern panics in scalar-list quantifier projections and
return the existing unsupported projection error. Propagate
FetchNodeProperties iteration errors and add regressions for both paths.

Refs: DAWGS-003, DAWGS-100
commits.review_note: The changeset also contains the DAWGS-100 iteration-error repair.

commits.message:
fix(cypher): complete literal null predicates safely

Push assembled IS/IS NOT predicates, infer their Boolean result
independently of operand compatibility, and reject empty expression
stacks. Cover scalar projections, WHERE filters and mutation selection.

Refs: DAWGS-004

fix(pg): reject unsupported temporal components and contain panics

Return explicit errors for component access on constructed temporal
values and convert compiler panics into errors in both translation-cache
paths. Restore complexity analysis for non-variable property atoms.

Refs: DAWGS-011

fix(pg): reject unsupported aggregate pattern predicates

Return explicit producer-boundary errors for pattern predicates in
aggregate traversal MATCH filters. Avoid the panic without falling back
to an equally unsupported generic translation.

Refs: DAWGS-030

fix(query): reject empty v2 kind predicates and mutations

Validate empty kind filters, assignments and removals at Build,
including hand-built matchers and Boolean nesting. Retain populated-kind
rendering.

Refs: DAWGS-086

fix(cypher): preserve repeated NOT parity

Apply even/odd negation parity in both frontend expression paths. Add
parser, SQL and shared read/mutation regressions.

Refs: DAWGS-008

fix(pg): preserve float literals and exact JSON integers

Keep fractional suffixes on integral float literals in both emitters.
Install connection-local JSON codecs that preserve signed 64-bit integer
tokens across scalar, collection and graph-composite results.

Refs: DAWGS-009, DAWGS-051

fix(pg): preserve decoded JSON string contents

Decode only raw JSON bytes instead of interpreting strings already
decoded by pgx a second time. Cover scalar, nested, wire and committed
mutation-result identities.

Refs: DAWGS-057

fix(pg): dispatch property arithmetic by stored value type

Select arithmetic behavior from JSON value types instead of text
coercion. Cover integer precision, floating remainder, strings, lists,
nulls and complete mutation post-state.

Refs: DAWGS-016

fix(pg): preserve typed predicate and comparison semantics

Guard both operands of nullable string predicates and compare compatible
dynamic JSON types, including lexicographic lists. Extend shared
read/mutation controls and schema helper coverage.

Refs: DAWGS-018

fix(pg): preserve property types through WITH consumers

Retain stored values through aliases, casts, string/list functions,
Boolean predicates and heterogeneous coalesce. Add shared result and
mutation-state regressions.

Refs: DAWGS-052

fix(pg): preserve exact numeric SUM semantics

Keep integer precision, honor DISTINCT and return zero for empty or
all-null SUM inputs. Add typed result, alias and complete mutation-state
controls.

Refs: DAWGS-053

fix(pg): preserve collection and UNWIND value types

Retain JSON scalar types in property collections, list operations and
UNWIND. Cover heterogeneous values, committed properties and complete
mutation state.

Refs: DAWGS-054

fix(pg): retain entity types in ID-only collections

Carry node/relationship element identity through collection projections
and scope copies so overlapping numeric IDs cannot match the wrong
entity type. Add shared membership and committed-state controls.

Refs: DAWGS-056

commits.original_subject: fix: test drift due to latest fixes
commits.message:
fix(pg): distinguish explicit timestamp zones from time.Local

Classify local timestamps by location identity rather than zone name.
Cover parameter cache rebinding, temporal error boundaries and
backend-selected integration tags without requiring a database for unit
tests.
commits.review_note: This changes timestamp behavior as well as test setup; it is not only fixture drift.

commits.message:
fix(pg): truncate numeric toInteger conversions toward zero

Preserve exact integer inputs while truncating fractional literals,
parameters, properties and aliases toward zero. Cover signed boundaries,
result types and mutation expressions.

Refs: DAWGS-015

fix(pg): escape LIKE metacharacters in string predicates

Treat percent, underscore and escape characters literally for CONTAINS,
STARTS WITH and ENDS WITH across supported operand shapes. Add shared
read and complete mutation-state templates.

Refs: DAWGS-014

fix(pg): preserve WITH ordering and pagination

Materialize read-only WITH ordering, alias resolution, SKIP and LIMIT
before later filtering and writes. Preserve input cardinality across
multipart boundaries.

Refs: DAWGS-040

fix(pg): preserve the implicit row in leading OPTIONAL MATCH

Supply one implicit input row and retain matched-side predicates so
unmatched patterns yield null bindings. Cover aggregation, chained
optionals, paths and mutations.

Refs: DAWGS-021

fix(pg): retain CREATE property and UNWIND element types

Copy stored JSON values into CREATE maps, retain native-array UNWIND
element types and read multipart OPTIONAL inputs from the preceding
frame. Validate corpus record assertions, support template schema kinds
and normalize tagged instants.
commits.review_note: The original test-drift subject hides three translator fixes and corpus workflow changes.

commits.message:
fix(pg): preserve MATCH pattern predicate lifetime

Resolve predicate futures once with their type constraints and
materialize pending filters before a later MATCH changes the correlation
frame. Cover repeated predicates and exact mutation selection.

Refs: DAWGS-036

fix(pg): retain pattern predicate dependencies before writes

Include node and relationship references in optimizer dependencies so
unresolved bindings stay pinned. Apply deferred MATCH filters before
mutations, including writes without RETURN.

Refs: DAWGS-035

fix(pg): preserve multipart traversal input boundaries

Read preceding materialized frames instead of enclosing WITH outputs and
keep duplicate/empty streams through literal projections. Cover exact
paths and SET/CREATE post-state.

Refs: DAWGS-046

fix(pg): enforce plain DELETE and graph-scoped detach cleanup

Reject plain node DELETE when incident relationships remain outside the
deletion set. Apply DETACH cleanup on parent and partition paths with
graph-scoped endpoint identity.

Refs: DAWGS-039

fix(pg): resolve ORDER BY aliases by binding identity

Expand nested aliases with grouping, qualify bare UNWIND inputs and
carry hidden DISTINCT sort keys. Preserve visible columns, ordering,
pagination and mutation selection.

Refs: DAWGS-047

fix(pg): retain property-list UNWIND types and input rows

Preserve JSON element types through direct properties, WITH aliases and
nested lists. Materialize pending UNWIND inputs before SET while
retaining duplicates and empty streams.

Refs: DAWGS-042

fix(pg): preserve DELETE continuation and write visibility

Reserve DELETE CTE names without advancing the input stream so final
projections retain cardinality and captured values. Stage preceding
SET/CREATE writes before DELETE in the same transaction.

Refs: DAWGS-043

test(cypher): normalize mutation and property UNWIND fixtures

Refresh parser mutation cases to canonical formatting and remove a
duplicate license header from the generated property-UNWIND SQL fixture.

fix(pg): treat unknown MATCH kinds as empty matches

Resolve absent kinds without registration while preserving alternatives,
conjunctions, negation and OPTIONAL MATCH. Bypass translation retention
for missing-kind plans so later registration becomes visible.

Refs: DAWGS-023

fix(cypher): reject unsupported list indexing explicitly

Return a located parser error and isolate the indexing subtree before
PostgreSQL execution. Cover read/mutation rejection and native Neo4j
pass-through; full shared indexing support remains open.

Refs: DAWGS-001

fix(cypher): reject unsupported list slicing explicitly

Return a located parser error for omitted, negative, parameterized and
chained slice bounds. Cover rejection before writes and native Neo4j
slicing; full shared slicing support remains open.

Refs: DAWGS-002

fix(cypher): reject unsupported standalone CALL explicitly

Return a located parser error for explicit and implicit procedure
invocations, including YIELD, instead of a successful nil AST. Preserve
native Neo4j procedure execution.

Refs: DAWGS-017

fix(cypher): reject unsupported shortest-path expressions

Isolate expression subtrees and return located parser errors instead of
projecting the terminal node. Retain supported MATCH syntax and native
Neo4j expressions.

Refs: DAWGS-010

fix(cypher): reject unsupported import and legacy clauses

Return located errors for CREATE UNIQUE and LOAD CSV before PostgreSQL
text execution, including preceding writes. Preserve native Neo4j query
text and diagnostics.

Refs: DAWGS-013

fix(cypher): reject unsupported in-query CALL explicitly

Isolate the invocation subtree and return a located parser error instead
of dropping arguments or YIELD filters from PostgreSQL execution. Cover
read/mutation rejection and native procedure controls.

Refs: DAWGS-103
commits.review_note: The original DAWGS-059 subject is swapped with 68ac7243; this is DAWGS-103 containment.

commits.message:
fix(neo4j): intersect conjunctive relationship-kind filters

Intersect positive conjunctive kind lists and retain an explicit false
predicate for disjoint sets. Keep OR, XOR and NOT filters in WHERE so
reads and mutations select the intended relationships.

Refs: DAWGS-059
commits.review_note: The original DAWGS-103 subject is swapped with be062e7e; this is the DAWGS-059 builder repair.

commits.message:
fix(cypher): preserve raw-query rewrite fidelity

Render qualified function separators and conjunctive parsed labels while
retaining builder any-kind OR behavior and float literal types. Add
shared read/mutation and native namespaced-function controls.

Refs: DAWGS-060

fix(cypher): retain XOR grouping inside conjunctions

Parenthesize builder XOR groups inside AND and group PostgreSQL XOR
operands and results. Add render, SQL and shared truth-table
read/mutation controls.

Refs: DAWGS-085

fix(pg): preserve escaped identifier spelling and result keys

Decode Cypher identifier escapes, retain case and double embedded SQL
quotes. Apply the same rendering to CTE names and cover exact result
keys and mutation targets.

Refs: DAWGS-055

commits.original_subject: fix+chore: release prep and carving out remaining work
commits.message:
fix(drivers): repair schema, kind and traversal release blockers

Separate graph selection from schema reconciliation and use
transaction-owned connections for kind mapping with commit-only metadata
publication. Remove implicit open-traversal depth caps, add explicit
resource failures and rollback, and repair shortest-path length and
bounded endpoint workspaces.

Quote Neo4j upsert identifiers and reconcile the active/completed
variance ledgers. Preserve the regex default and recorded
capacity/performance limits; the ledger does not qualify the complete
PostgreSQL release gate as passing.

Refs: DAWGS-019, DAWGS-061, DAWGS-063, DAWGS-065
commits.review_note: Includes the bounded shortest-path workspace follow-up as well as the four release repairs; GraphBench changes are formatting only.
